versions.title: drawgen.co as it was
versions.note: Archive of the live drawgen.co on 25 September 2026: the home page, the product page and the six industry pages, kept as full-page screenshots. Quoting for manufacturers who build to order, on a forest green and signal cyan palette, with a hero and industry headers close to tacto.ai.

versions.title: The symbol at work
versions.note: Same copy and positioning, rebuilt from the founders' Astro source, with a signal mint accent in the family of the forest green. The home hero puts the headline across the page and builds the starting price on an example assembly, each line lighting the parts it comes from; what it costs you and why now becomes a ledger with a drawing per sourced number; industry cards come forward on hover with the plane outlined in mint; the close and the footer become one full screen with a lit wordmark. Every Product menu item has its own page, and the Industries menu carries generated industry photographs, credited in credits.json.
